messages:
lina: Quick FYI — onboarding gulliver-mini (PTQ-4) to canary. Noticed sporadic drops of `actions` objects during streaming tool-invokes. Small trace attached.

alex: Can you paste the raw chunks? curious where it splits.

lina: Paste below (keeps order):

```
{"type":"chunk","text":"{\"req_id\":\"r42\",\"out\":{\"status\":\"ok\",\"actions\":[{\"op\":\"write\",\"path\":\"/var/log/x\",\"args\":{\""}
```

```
{"type":"chunk","text":"\"content\":\"hello\"}}]} }\n"}
```

lina: Reassembled sometimes yields missing actions array (null) or parser throw. Seems worse on PTQ-4 vs fp16.

pranav: Metrics? how big is the difference?

lina: fp16 ~0.8% parse-fail on this test harness. PTQ-4 ~5-6%.

alex: Likely tokenization/stream cut at boundary. Two quick mitigations: 1) length-prefixed ndjson framing at runtime edge, 2) fallback to non-streaming on parse error.

lina: We tried sentinel markers (<<JSON_START>> / <<JSON_END>>). That reduced failures but added latency ~25-50ms per call.

ops-bot: canary deploy 6321007777: feature flag `stream_frame=length_prefixed` toggled ON at 09:14 UTC.

pranav: Also suspect shard-aligned kv-cache/split that changes tokenization. Try running with single-shard runtime to compare.

lina: Good idea — running single-shard + length-prefetch today across 2k prompts. Will report parse-fail, average latency, and retry counts here.

alex: I'll sketch a tiny harness that simulates adversarial chunk splits and runs across fp16, ptq4, and hybrid-quant. Expect to see PTQ bias toward shorter subtokenization causing splits mid-utf8 sequences.

lina: Thanks. Posting results in-thread once done. :wave:
